description: X is a social platform centered on posts, users, messaging, trends, and advertising. Its developer platform provides APIs and tools for accessing public conversation, managing ads, and building chat or automation integrations.
summary: x.com exposes a REST X API at api.x.com/2, an Ads API at ads-api.x.com, hosted MCP servers for X API and Ads, and the xurl CLI; auth is required via bearer tokens, OAuth 2.0, or OAuth 1.0a depending on surface.
